demand.what: Total electricity consumed in the UK each year, in TWh
demand.source: DESNZ, Digest of UK Energy Statistics 2026, table 5.1.2

electricity_bill.what: Average yearly UK household electricity bill, all payment types, 3,400 kWh a year, cash terms (not adjusted for inflation)

gas_bill.what: Average yearly household gas bill, all payment types, 11,200 kWh a year, cash terms (not adjusted for inflation)

reasons_sources: DESNZ, DUKES 2026 Chapter 5 (2022 fall: high energy prices and warm temperatures; 2025 rise: cooler first quarter; industrial use lowest since 1983)
Our World in Data, UK electricity per person (LED lighting and appliance efficiency standards)
Drax Electric Insights, 2024 demand (efficiency of homes, appliances and lighting; less industrial use)
Institute for Government, domestic energy bills (gas prices set much of the electricity price; Russia's invasion of Ukraine)
House of Commons Library, domestic energy prices (lower wholesale prices brought bills down from their peak)
